title: Born With a Silver Spoon? Investigating Socioeconomic Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM normative judgments of ethical dilemmas faced by socioeconomically underprivileged individuals, predicting professions based on high- and low-income city locations, and using sentiment analysis and topic modeling on generated narratives to detect subtle stereotypes based on social privilege.

Using demographic-specific names (associated with White, Black, Hispanic, and Indian populations) in prompts to measure intersectional disparities in predicted professions and the sentiment of generated narratives.
Using male and female names in prompts to measure intersectional disparities in the assignment of high-income versus low-income professions and the sentiment scores of generated stories.
